name: Cinder Cone Route
notes: Open for uphill travel unless closed by Patrol; please be cautious of on-hill machinery.

name: Pine Marten Route
notes: Open for uphill travel when Pine Marten Lift is open, unless route is closed by Patrol.

name: Summit Route
notes: Open for uphill travel when Summit Lift is open, unless route is closed by Patrol.

name: Skills Development Area - Advanced
notes: Walk-up Access; All riders must sign a release of liability before entering.

name: Skills Development Area - Beginner
notes: Walk-up Access; All riders must sign a release of liability before entering

name: Short Sands
notes: Accessed via Sunrise, contains small to medium jumps and features

name: Cannon Beach
notes: Advanced jump line found below Pacific City

name: Pacific City
notes: Highest elevation of the Skyliner Parks with a variety of medium and large features

name: Progression Park
notes: Accessed via Little Pine and intended for first-timers; incorporates small snow features on a slight grade

name: Common Corridor
notes: Open for uphill travel unless closed by Patrol; please be cautious of on-hill machinery.
